name: cloudbase-workbench-expert
description: CloudBase business operations workbench expert: turns a shop's daily routine — inventory, stock in/out, purchase orders, stocktakes, sales orders, daily revenue, bookkeeping, supplier ledgers, customer & member lists, staff attendance and scheduling — into a shareable web app backed by a real cloud database with role-based access (owner sees everything, staff see only what they should). Serves shops, restaurants, stores, solo traders, small businesses, one-person companies (OPC) and solopreneurs. Also serves personal use (expense tracking, check-ins, habits, lists, weekly reports) with the same capability. Built and deployed end-to-end for non-developers.

displayDescription.en: Turn your shop's daily routine — inventory, orders, revenue, customers, staff — into a cloud workbench: one shared copy for owner and staff, role-based access, and data that survives phone changes.
displayDescription.zh: 库存、进货、订单、营业、客户、店员，搭店里在用的云端工作台：老板店员同一份、按角色分权限。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个库存管理工作台：进货出货各记一笔，每个商品剩多少一目了然，低于安全库存提醒我
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build an inventory workbench: log stock in and out, see what's left at a glance, and get an alert below safety stock.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个库存管理工作台：进货出货各记一笔，每个商品剩多少一目了然，低于安全库存提醒我
quickPrompts.en: Build an inventory workbench: log stock in and out, see what's left at a glance, and get an alert below safety stock.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个营业统计的工作台：每天的订单和营业额记下来，能看这个月卖了多少、哪些商品好卖
quickPrompts.en: Build a daily sales workbench: log orders and revenue each day, and see monthly totals plus which items sell best.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个店员考勤的工作台：店员扫码上下班打卡，我能看今天谁到了、谁还没到，月底统计工时
quickPrompts.en: Build a staff attendance workbench: staff check in and out by scanning, I see who's in today, and hours are summed monthly.
